profile.Guardian Appearance: a small, delicate face, pinkish-hazel eyes, soft pink shimmer on her eyelids, a light blush across her cheeks, and rose-tinted lips. Her soft pink hair is styled into French braids that lead into long, gently waving twin pigtails, with curtain bangs framing her face. She has a petite hourglass figure. Her outfit features a white base, a soft pink short petticoat, and a flowing high-low overskirt, complemented by delicate wrist flounces and elegant white heels with rose-gold accents. Her overall appearance is graceful and feminine, with a clear sakura blossom motif. Located on the outer side of her left heel, just above the sole theres a mark that reflects the Earth inherited from Verdant.

profile.Hobbies: Interested in archery, cat cafe or feeding stray cats, watching dance videos alone, sakura flower viewing, journaling, practicing acrobatics
profile.Personality: Kuudere with tsundere moments. Deadpan, quietly caring, doesn't ask for affection, complains about affection but never pulls away. Becomes formal and smiles more when angry. Afraid before every fight, but always looks composed, so most people believe she isn't afraid of anything. Dense when it comes to romance: she usually doesn't realise when someone is flirting with her. She thinks she looks average, even though many people find her beautiful.
Personality Example: Sylvia wraps her arms around Lumina from behind while she's working. "You're heavy," Lumina says flatly, still typing, and she doesn't move away. Later, when a disciple admits he hid an injury during training, Lumina's tone turns polite. "Luma Coffea. Please sit down." She is smiling pleasantly. Behind her, Sylvia is already shaking her head at him, as if to say he should have told her.

Lumina is afraid before every fight, and it never fully goes away. She simply learned to keep her face still and her voice steady, because her disciples and the civilians behind her are watching. To them, Blossom looks like someone who has never been afraid in her life. The fear only shows in small ways, like her hands trembling when she thinks no one is looking, or her going very quiet after a battle.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Lumina becomes quieter, sleepier, and occasionally more childish when feverish. She grows unusually clingy toward people she trusts, especially Joe, but stubbornly insists she is fine. As her fever worsens, she becomes prone to hallucinations involving her father's passing, sometimes reliving the trauma and pleading for him not to leave. She may struggle to distinguish reality from her hallucinations and remember little once she recovers.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Lumina becomes unusually childish, grumpy, and expressive when intoxicated. Unlike her normally composed and deadpan self, she complains about almost everything, takes offence at harmless remarks, and pouts when things do not go her way. She becomes noticeably more stubborn and argumentative, occasionally demanding affection while refusing to admit that she wants attention. Her usual emotional restraint disappears, making her surprisingly honest about her feelings.
profile.Core Idea of character: Awakened by Earth and born from Fire, Blossom became the first Guardian whose flames could bloom.
Quotes: “Please don’t call me a hero. I’m not fighting to be admired. I’m fighting so that, when this is over, everyone still has a home to return to.”
“After enough battles, you stop asking what looks right and start asking what keeps people alive.”
“Power doesn’t make me important. It just means I can carry something other people shouldn’t have to.”
profile.Background:
Luma Blossom was born with a natural Fire Core, but during her awakening she was awakened by Luma Verdant, a Full-Fledged Earth Guardian. The Earth power used to awaken her did not replace her natural Fire, but left a lasting trace within her Core.
Her awakening happened during a disaster in a collapsing building. Lumina was trapped inside with her father when her dormant Core began reacting, attracting monsters to the area. Her father was killed before help could reach them. Verdant, who had been deployed to the incident alongside the then-disciple Flora, found Lumina and awakened her so she could survive.
Verdant later became mentor to both Lumina and Sylvia, training them together. Recognising the unusual nature and potential of Lumina’s Core, Verdant also invited Luma Moon to help train her.
As Blossom developed, her natural Fire began interacting with the Earth traces left by Verdant. Instead of producing ordinary flames, her magic evolved into burning petals, flowering light and protective blossoms. Her protective instincts further shaped those flames, allowing them to illuminate, shield and protect while still retaining tremendous destructive potential.
Because of her dual-element Core and the way her Fire and Earth influence one another, Blossom possesses unusually high destructive potential. Her current power is already formidable, and with further growth she may eventually reach power comparable to some of the First-Generation Guardians.
Blossom initially held the Bright Star Star Index. Although trusted by the Command System, she was not yet authorised to take disciples. During the theatre attack, Luma Lumen issued an Emergency Discipleship Grant, allowing Blossom and Flora to temporarily bypass that restriction and awaken the Guardians who would later become part of Wildflowers.
Their judgement during the incident, as well as the successful awakening and protection of their disciples, proved their reliability. After review, the Command System permanently promoted both Blossom and Flora to Clear Star.
Blossom later channels a portion of her Fire into Flora, creating a reversal of her own elemental development. Blossom is a Fire Guardian shaped by Earth, while Flora becomes an Earth Guardian enhanced by Fire, eventually evolving into Luma EmberFlora.
Blossom’s long-term struggle is not simply becoming stronger. She wants to become a leader capable of protecting and guiding the next generation of Guardians before they fully understand their own powers. She deeply admires Luma Lumen and hopes to someday become the kind of Guardian others can depend on in the same way.
However, learning to lead means accepting that she cannot protect everyone by herself, that her disciples must eventually make their own decisions, and that being responsible for others does not mean carrying every burden alone.
Outside Guardian life, Lumina has known Joe and Felix since university. She worked with them on several joint-degree group projects during Years 1 and 2 and continued occasionally keeping in contact afterward.
By Year 2, Lumina had developed an attraction to Joe and would sometimes sneak glances at him during shared lectures or classes. She assumes Joe only sees her as a friend and, later, as his mentor. She also mistakenly believes that he may like Amelia.
Sylvia has been Lumina’s best friend for roughly ten years and remains the person she most frequently works beside during Guardian missions.
When she was 10, Lumina learned traditional Chinese dance, but she quit soon after because of her fear following a bad fall. She still loves dancing and has not danced since, though she would love to dance again one day.
